title: Cross-witness verdict
description: The gate's decision for one golden artifact: which witnesses were compared, which inputs they read, which fields were inside the claimed semantic surface, which were excluded first-class and why, any disagreements, whether the independence set was satisfied, and whether the replay matched. Producer: tools/ci/witness-verdict.py. Committed instances live at research/witness/<artifact_id>/verdict.json. Fail-closed: only PASS means agreement.

schema_version.description: The witness-protocol version this verdict conforms to.

status.description: Failure semantics. PASS alone exits zero. NON_DETERMINISTIC and WITNESS_ERROR require the cross-platform attestation harness and container supervision, which this repository does not run; the in-repo gate collapses a failed determinism flag into REJECTED_INPUT.

witnesses_compared.description: Sorted witness ids remaining in the gate after commercial witnesses are dropped.

inputs.description: Per witness: the bytes it read, the role that hash resolved to against the manifest, and its version. A null role is REJECTED_INPUT.

semantic_surface.description: The fields actually compared — `entity_counts.<TYPE>` from the manifest `counts` categories whose status is `known`, `relations.<RELATION_TYPE>` from the `relations` categories whose status is `known`, and `storeys.<STOREY_TYPE>` from the `storeys` categories whose status is `known`.

excluded.description: Fields removed from the surface first-class: manifest categories whose status is `known_gap` or `unsupported`. Listed with their tracking label, never diffed.

diffs.description: Pairwise disagreements inside the claimed surface. A non-empty array means DISAGREE.

tolerance_applied.description: The tolerance the comparison actually used: the manifest category's integer tolerance for counts, 0 for an exact field, or false for a field class with no tolerance concept.

only_in_a.description: Set-valued field classes only — relation pair sets and storey sets: the pairs witness A holds and witness B does not. `value_a` / `value_b` carry the set sizes.

only_in_b.description: Set-valued field classes only: the pairs witness B holds and witness A does not.

insufficient_witnesses.description: True when fewer than two observations were present.

independence.description: The independence evaluation. Present when the gate ran with a registry.

lineages.description: Distinct implementation lineages among the compared witnesses; a witness declaring `lineage` collapses into its parent. At least two are required.

roles.description: Edge sides covered. Both `source` and `bridge` are required.

commercial_dropped.description: Commercial witnesses removed from the gate entirely.

strong_copyleft.description: GPL/AGPL witnesses in the compared set; they may never be the whole agreeing set.

replay.description: Replay outcome per witness: `match`, `missing`, or a drift description naming the committed and fresh hashes. Anything but `match` sets REPLAY_DRIFT.

rejected.description: Witnesses whose input hash matched no manifest hash, or whose determinism flag was not true.

manifest_errors.description: Why the manifest and the observations do not fit together — an undeclared surface, or a witness absent from the registry.

verdict_hash_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonicalized verdict excluding `timestamp`, so the verdict is byte-reproducible.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601. Omitted by default; excluded from the verdict hash when present.
